entities.name: Carlos Álvarez-Nóvoa
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Carlos Álvarez-Nóvoa Sánchez was a Spanish theatre director, writer, actor and lecturer. He won the 2000 Goya award for Best New Actor for his performance as Vecino in Solas. He died on 23 September 2015 from lung cancer at the age of 75.
